telem2_wiring_reference.pin_numbering: Verify connector orientation against the manufacturer diagram for the specific board revision.
warnings: Verify companion UART voltage compatibility and power/current requirements before connecting VCC; never assume the +5 V pin can power an onboard computer.
Review board supply limits, companion startup/peak demand, back-powering and approved power arrangement; leave VCC unconnected until verified.
UART signals are 3.3 V, not 5 V logic or RS-232 levels.
Match TX to RX and common GND; telemetry-only receive wiring does not require companion TX to flight-controller RX.
Use CTS/RTS only when both sides support and are configured for hardware flow control: controller CTS to companion RTS, controller RTS to companion CTS.
Otherwise leave CTS/RTS disconnected and explicitly review no-flow-control settings at both endpoints; pin availability does not prove support in the gateway.
Opening a serial device may change DTR/line states; no physical one-way isolation or electrical validation is established.

autopilot_alternatives.port_role: TELEM2 documented as default onboard/companion MAVLink port

telem2_profile_example.basis: Usual PX4 companion-port defaults in upstream main documentation; inspect specific board revision, installed firmware, port ownership and saved parameters.
caveats: MAV_1_RATE=0 means half the theoretical maximum bytes/second, not serial baud or zero traffic.
Select the serial port and reboot to expose parameters, then set baud/profile; reboot where required and inspect saved values.
Match companion/router baud explicitly; hardware, adapter and link capacity may require a different mutually supported rate.
Inspect MAV_1_FLOW_CTRL against installed firmware and wiring; no RTS/CTS value is selected by this example.
Gateway CLI exposes --baud but no RTS/CTS flag; firmware settings alone do not establish end-to-end flow-control support.
MAV_1_FORWARD=Disabled is not physical one-way isolation.

autopilot_alternatives.port_role: SERIAL2 maps to UART5/TELEM2 with RTS/CTS pins

telem2_profile_example.basis: SERIAL2 maps to UART5/TELEM2 on Pixhawk 6C only; baud is an explicitly chosen illustration, not an asserted firmware default.
caveats: SERIAL2_PROTOCOL=2 explicitly selects MAVLink2; general telemetry defaults may be MAVLink1. MAVLink2 alone does not provision or enable signing.
Official parameter metadata encodes SERIAL2_BAUD=115 as 115200 baud and 921 as 921600 baud; inspect the installed firmware metadata.
Do not assume ArduCopter baud defaults equal PX4 defaults or the gateway CLI default; set matching rates explicitly at both endpoints.
BRD_SER2_RTSCTS=0 is the no-flow-control example only; 1 Enabled and 2 Auto require reviewed compatible peer configuration and CTS/RTS wiring.
Reboot where required by firmware metadata after protocol/flow-control changes and inspect saved values.
Logical serial numbering is board-specific; stream indices do not necessarily match SERIALx numbers.
The receiver requires active firmware-side streams and exposes no RTS/CTS configuration flag.

reference_scope: Cross-stack Pixhawk 6C quadrotor example, not confirmed owner hardware; inspect against the specific board revision and installed firmware. No hardware changes or safety certification.
